+.required_evaluation_semantics: Evaluate operands left to right and add them. An empty argument list yields FIX zero. A FLOAT operand promotes the arithmetic per the manual's numeric rules.
+.identity_and_mutation: Returns a numeric value with no operand mutation.
+.error_behavior: Arguments must be numbers. Historical overflow behavior warrants separate tests.

/.required_evaluation_semantics: Divide the first operand by successive divisors. A FIX/FIX intermediate truncates before a later FLOAT operand promotes it.
/.error_behavior: Non-numeric operands and zero divisors fail.

LVAL.required_evaluation_semantics: Return an ATOM's local value in the selected or running environment. A leading dot abbreviates an application of LVAL.
LVAL.identity_and_mutation: Return the bound object itself without changing the binding.
LVAL.error_behavior: Unassigned local value is an error. The manual requires an ATOM; the current implementation has #121.

UNASSIGN.required_evaluation_semantics: Remove the assigned local value of an ATOM, including if already unassigned.
UNASSIGN.identity_and_mutation: Affects the selected ATOM binding rather than the object previously bound.

GETPROP.required_evaluation_semantics: Evaluate the call arguments normally. On a miss, evaluate the supplied fallback again or return MDL FALSE when absent.
GETPROP.identity_and_mutation: Both selectors must match by ==?. A FIX indicator always looks in association space. A hit returns the stored object.
GETPROP.error_behavior: A numeric indicator does not cause an index-range error. A missing property is an ordinary result.

PUTPROP.required_evaluation_semantics: Associate a value and return the item. With no value argument, remove an association and return the old value or MDL FALSE, per the manual.
PUTPROP.identity_and_mutation: Both selectors match by ==?. Numeric indicators do not write structure elements. Associations may disappear when keys become unreachable and no locative retains them.
PUTPROP.error_behavior: The item, indicator and value may be any MDL objects. An out-of-range FIX remains a valid association indicator.

GET.required_evaluation_semantics: Use element access for a structured item and FIX or OFFSET selector, otherwise use association lookup.
GET.identity_and_mutation: The retrieval returns the selected object. Association keys match by ==?.
GET.error_behavior: An invalid element index fails. An association miss uses the supplied fallback or MDL FALSE.

PUT.required_evaluation_semantics: Use element mutation for a structured item and FIX or OFFSET selector, otherwise use association storage and removal.
PUT.identity_and_mutation: Element writes preserve sharing with other views. Association keys match by ==?.
PUT.error_behavior: Structure index errors still apply to the indexed branch.
PUT.deviation: ADR-0023: two-argument association removal returns the item per pinned Confusion, whereas the manual specifies the removed value.

DECL?.required_evaluation_semantics: Test whether an object matches a declaration Pattern.
DECL?.deviation: ADR-0023 and M2 D3 preserve Confusion's diagnostic FALSE payload for element/pattern mismatches.

UNWIND.required_evaluation_semantics: Evaluate the primary expression. When an MDL in-flight transfer crosses the frame, evaluate cleanup in the original environment, ignore its result and continue the transfer.
UNWIND.identity_and_mutation: Normal return leaves cleanup unevaluated. An actual cleanup may mutate objects.

PRINT.required_evaluation_semantics: Emit a newline, the read representation of the evaluated value and a following space. Return the evaluated value.
PRINT.identity_and_mutation: Returns the argument object and writes to the selected output CHANNEL.

%.required_evaluation_semantics: During READ, evaluate the next object immediately and insert the resulting object in the read structure.
%.identity_and_mutation: The evaluated result keeps its identity and side effects happen in source order.

%%.required_evaluation_semantics: During READ, evaluate the next object immediately, retain side effects and discard its value.

EVAL.required_evaluation_semantics: Evaluate an MDL object in the supplied environment or the current one, using its evaluation type.

SETLOC.required_evaluation_semantics: Write an evaluated value to the storage location designated by a locative.
SETLOC.identity_and_mutation: A change is visible to users of the corresponding location, including aliased views.
